one_line: A young Gandharan scholar-warrior training in the cosmopolitan learning city of Takshashila at the crossroads of ancient cultures.

appearance.face: oval face, light brown Gandharan complexion with a warm undertone, straight nose, sharp brows, large anime-style eyes, a thin healed scar across the left eyebrow, default expression focused and observant with a calm half‑smile
appearance.hair: thick straight black hair tied into a short topknot at the crown with the sides neatly combed back, a narrow dark red cloth headband circling the forehead under the knot, no facial hair
appearance.costume: long-sleeved knee-length white cotton tunic (kurta-like) with a simple round neckline and side slits, worn over fitted mid‑brown trousers tied at the waist with a plain dark brown leather belt; over the tunic a draped light indigo woolen shawl (Gandharan chadar) with a subtle narrow border in muted gold running along its edges, typically slung over the left shoulder and wrapped across the chest; on his feet simple dark brown leather sandals with thong straps; small silver ear studs in both ears and a single plain bronze bangle on his right wrist, textiles slightly worn to suggest travel but neatly kept
appearance.signature: a rolled birch-bark manuscript secured with a thin leather thong, carried together with a short wooden writing tablet and stylus in his left hand, while a modest sheathed Indo-Gandharan short sword with a simple straight crossguard and wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather hangs diagonally at his left hip from his belt as a secondary symbol of frontier discipline rather than primary weapon

ref_desc: A lean early‑20s Gandharan student with an oval light brown face, black topknot and red headband, wearing a white tunic, brown trousers, indigo shawl with muted gold border and sandals, carrying a birch‑bark manuscript and short sword in a white, indigo, brown and gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a young Gandharan student from ancient Takshashila: a lean early‑20s man with an oval light brown face, sharp brows, large focused eyes and a thin scar on his left eyebrow, black hair tied in a short topknot with a narrow dark red cloth headband. Show him in a long-sleeved knee-length white cotton tunic with a simple round neck, worn over fitted mid‑brown trousers and a plain dark brown leather belt, with a light indigo woolen shawl draped over his left shoulder and across his chest, its edges marked by a subtle muted gold border. Include small silver ear studs, a single bronze bangle on his right wrist, and simple dark brown leather thong sandals. At his left hip, hang a modest Indo-Gandharan short sword in a plain sheath with straight crossguard and dark leather-wrapped wooden hilt, while in his left hand he holds a rolled birch-bark manuscript bound with a thin leather thong alongside a short wooden writing tablet and stylus. Keep colors consistent in white, light indigo, brown tones and muted gold, and present him front, side and back to clearly show hair, face, shawl drape, belt, sword placement, and scholarly props.
